summary: PropTech Turkey - server.py modularization & React array key anti-pattern fix testing. Backend: 24/24 tests passed (all required endpoints working). Frontend: homepage, e-Konut, education pages loading correctly. Login flow (testuser) working. Admin panel working after 2 critical bug fixes applied.

minor.endpoint: Legacy test files (test_proptech_admin.py, test_admin_users.py, test_seo_endpoints.py, test_project_excel_import.py)
minor.issue: Pre-existing issue: These older test files expect 'access_token' key in admin login response but API returns 'token'. 73 ERRORs in fixture setup. Not related to current changes.

ui_bugs.issue: When admin navigates to /admin without a session, the api.js 401 interceptor (window.location.href='/auth') fires before AdminLogin form can be used. Admin is always redirected to /auth (user login page) when no admin_token cookie exists. Admin can only access /admin if they already have a valid admin_token cookie. AdminLogin form in AdminPanelPage is effectively inaccessible for fresh sessions.

issues: 1792 lines - exceeds 700-line file size guideline, should be split into sub-components/modals

bugs_fixed.bug: HTTPBearer(auto_error=True) only accepted Bearer tokens. After cookie migration, admin panel frontend sends admin_token cookie (not Bearer). All admin/* endpoints returned 403. Fix: Changed to HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) and updated get_current_user to accept both Bearer token AND admin_token cookie.

useEffect /auth/me check had data.role === 'admin' but /auth/me response structure is {user: {...role}, type: 'admin'}. So data.role was always undefined, causing redirect to /auth even with valid admin cookie. Fix: Changed to data.user?.role === 'admin' and setUser(data.user).

action_items: MEDIUM: Fix admin fresh-login flow. When no admin_token cookie exists, admin is redirected to user /auth page and cannot login as admin. Options: (A) Add admin login endpoint check in /auth page (Partner Girişi tab should call /auth/login not /auth/user-login), or (B) Prevent the 401 interceptor from redirecting when on /admin route by using a separate axios instance or skipGlobalInterceptor flag for /auth/me call in AdminPanelPage.
LOW: Fix pre-existing test files (test_proptech_admin.py etc.) to use 'token' instead of 'access_token' in fixture setup.
LOW: Consider splitting AdminPanelPage.js (1792 lines) into smaller components.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_utils.py: get_current_user now correctly accepts both Bearer token and admin_token cookie - aligns with httpOnly cookie architecture
AdminPanelPage.js: The /auth/me response structure mismatch (data.role vs data.user.role) is now fixed
api.js 401 interceptor: Blanket redirect to /auth for ALL 401s prevents admin login form from working. Consider using auto_error=False + separate check, or whitelist /admin route from the redirect.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all pages load, user login works, admin panel works with cookie - initial admin login flow is broken)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two bugs were fixed in this iteration: (1) auth_utils.py now accepts admin_token cookie for Bearer-protected endpoints - admin panel stats now load correctly, (2) AdminPanelPage.js data.role → data.user.role fix for session restore. Remaining issue: admin cannot login fresh to /admin without a pre-existing cookie because the 401 interceptor in api.js redirects to /auth. Old test files (test_proptech_admin.py etc.) have pre-existing fixture failures (expect 'access_token' key). New test file: /app/backend/tests/test_modular_backend.py covers all 15 required endpoints.

admin_panel_403_bug.root_cause: During localStorage → httpOnly cookie migration, authHeaders() was changed to return {} (empty). This broke all admin API calls from frontend which used to send Bearer tokens via Authorization header. Backend require_admin still only accepted Bearer tokens.
admin_panel_403_bug.reproduction: Login as admin via form, navigate to admin panel, check Network tab - all /admin/* calls return 403
admin_panel_403_bug.mitigation: Updated get_current_user in auth_utils.py to accept admin_token cookie as fallback when no Bearer header present

admin_session_restore_bug.root_cause: AdminPanelPage useEffect checked data.role === 'admin' but /auth/me returns {user: {role: 'admin', ...}, type: 'admin'}. So data.role was always undefined and session could never be restored from cookie.
admin_session_restore_bug.reproduction: Login as admin, refresh /admin page - get redirected to /auth
admin_session_restore_bug.mitigation: Changed to userData?.role === 'admin' where userData = data.user || data
